ask._.vee: Yann Vee stepped off the supply cart at S-F10 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Yann Vee received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Yann Vee left the work of a rifleman to become a sapper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.
Now serving as a sniper, Yann Vee discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
Yann Vee (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) met in the same shell hole at Calvary Farm during a raid. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
At Calvary Farm, Teodor Acakostic of the Hegemony and Yann Vee of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.

A shouted challenge from Yann Vee (Concord) reached Gustav "Tin" Jul (Hegemony) at the Drowned Farm. The answer was lost beneath the guns. The challenge was not repeated. The Concord took Verdel Ridge, and the orders at S-F10 changed before the cheering ended. Yann Vee shouldered another load.
Dawn watch. Yann Vee put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Edmund Matteozrybak, badly wounded.

Yann Vee tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. A letter from home found Yann Vee before the night shift. Yann Vee folded it small and kept it close.

Yann Vee wrote a letter for Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's mother, because Saint could not find the words. Saint signed it. After the loss of Hill 304, Yann Vee helped stack spare sandbags at S-F10. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F10 and grazed Yann Vee's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Arno Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy). Yann Vee fired at a movement across the wire at S-F10. The man went down: Edmund Somosmagios, gravely wounded. A letter from home found Yann Vee before the night shift. Yann Vee folded it small and kept it close.
Yann Vee no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Yann Vee fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios was grazed.
Yann Vee let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios was badly wounded.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Yann Vee was hit hard in the fight at S-F10 before anyone could fire. The raider was Albin Sem of the Hegemony. Raider: Albin Sem of the Hegemony (@sem0235). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Yann Vee stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

The medics cleaned Yann Vee's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F10. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-F10. Yann Vee has learned to walk bent double.
Yann Vee lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.

Yann Vee and Emil Day both swear they saw a ghost at Saint-Ash crossroads. Each says the other screamed first. A letter from home found Yann Vee before the night shift. Yann Vee folded it small and kept it close.
Yann Vee had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Yann Somosmagios was gravely wounded.
A parcel from home held a comb. Yann Vee has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.

At S-F10 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Yann Vee turned around and took a shovel blow. Zeno Retarded of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Zeno Retarded of the Hegemony (@lud0_retarded). Yann Vee got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.
Yann Vee is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. A letter for Yann Vee came with a pressed flower inside. Yann Vee showed the flower to nobody.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Yann read a theatre review while peeling supper. A letter came for Yann from the man who owns the shop back home. It said Yann's job would be waiting. Yann read that line to the squad.
curze_okaski: Tobias Okaski joined the replacements on Day 12. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Tobias Okaski and Henrik Rossfm both swear they saw a ghost at Lantern Hill. Each says the other screamed first.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Tobias Okaski helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
Tobias Okaski spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Tobias Okaski saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
Tobias Okaski of the Concord lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at Saint-Ash crossroads. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Edmund "Spark" Slade's name scratched on the lid.
Tobias wrote letters for six men who could not write. It took the whole evening and a pencil.
cuyler_soccer26: Henrik "Shadow" Soccer took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Henrik "Shadow" Soccer let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Henrik "Shadow" Soccer received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Henrik "Shadow" Soccer answered to number 846. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Henrik "Shadow" Soccer during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Henrik "Shadow" Soccer moved to a new hide at S-C5 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Rafael Ware, badly wounded. Henrik "Shadow" Soccer lay behind a dead tree trunk at S-C5 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Gustav Simplepach was badly wounded.
Henrik "Shadow" Soccer's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.

Henrik "Shadow" Soccer had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Florian Jacobsoifu, badly wounded. Henrik "Shadow" Soccer was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-C5. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Walter "Parson" Roryhacon of the Concord (@roryhacon). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Henrik "Shadow" Soccer fell at S-C5 and never moved again. Shot by Walter "Parson" Roryhacon of the Concord (@roryhacon).
A letter came with Walter Soccer: "I am Henrik "Shadow" Soccer's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
The cook borrowed Walter Soccer's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Face blackened with soot, Walter Soccer spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Emil Awan was badly wounded.
Walter Soccer fired once through the steel loophole at S-C5 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Henrik Roryhacon was gravely wounded.
Walter and Cyril Rttr made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
its.samwade: "You're late," said the corporal when Ivo "Mud" Samwade arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-C6, Ivo "Mud" Samwade listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Ivo "Mud" Samwade agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ivo "Mud" Samwade is number 652. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Ivo "Mud" Samwade watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Ivo "Mud" Samwade has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-C6. Ivo "Mud" Samwade fired at the last man to run. Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu was grazed.
Across from R-C6, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Ivo "Mud" Samwade saw it. Dorian Yoollyfox was gravely wounded.
The artist tried again while Ivo "Mud" Samwade read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.

Ivo "Mud" Samwade was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-C6. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Felix "Tin" Euberitamini of the Hegemony (@euberitaminis).
Ivo "Mud" Samwade is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Ivo fired, and Gustav Dillonl was grazed.
jeremie_laval_meloche: Day 9. The corporal put Oskar Meloche beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Oskar Meloche shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

A bullet found Oskar Meloche at R-R6, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas of the Concord (@thomas833874). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Oskar Meloche fell at R-R6 and never moved again. Shot by Oskar "Rabbit" Thomas of the Concord (@thomas833874).

Arno "Shadow" Meloche arrived carrying the family name of Oskar Meloche. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Arno "Shadow" Meloche helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Arno "Shadow" Meloche raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R6. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Wendel Superfeisty of the Concord (@superfeisty7).

A round came through the loophole Arno "Shadow" Meloche was watching at R-R6 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Benedikt Aidanthompso of the Concord (@aidanthompson0319).

There were too few medics and too many wounded. Arno "Shadow" Meloche waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it. Arno "Shadow" Meloche was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door.
The bleeding has stopped. Arno "Shadow" Meloche asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Arno "Shadow" Meloche recovered anyway and is back at R-R6.
Arno "Shadow" Meloche fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Yann Mart, gravely wounded.

A bullet went through Arno's forearm at R-R6. The bone held, but the hand would not close. Two men carried him to the aid post. Shot by Wendel Schwols of the Concord (@erwin_schwols). Arno looked over the parapet at R-R6 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound.
Another member of the House of Meloche reached the line: Viktor Meloche. He asked where Arno "Shadow" Meloche had slept, then chose a different corner.
k1lean.tec: They issued Nils Tec a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept his mother's thimble in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

A bullet struck Nils Tec below the ribs at P-F9. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Felix Able of the Concord (@smabel_is_able). Nils Tec was killed at P-F9 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Felix Able of the Concord (@smabel_is_able).

The House of Tec sent Lucien "Parson" Tec after Nils Tec. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Lucien "Parson" Tec watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Lucien "Parson" Tec tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Lucien "Parson" Tec shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Leopold "Mole" Naturallefty, was grazed. Lucien "Parson" Tec was hit in the forearm at P-F9. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Lucien "Brick" Yuas of the Concord (@krauser.yuas).
Three days with a bandage, and Lucien "Parson" Tec is back at P-F9. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.

Lucien "Parson" Tec fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Ivo Abraham, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at P-F9 and grazed Lucien "Parson" Tec's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Walter "Spark" Cthulhu of the Concord (@cthulhu1703).

A bullet went through Lucien "Parson" Tec's upper arm at P-F9 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Lucien "Brick" Yuas of the Concord (@krauser.yuas). Lucien "Parson" Tec stood up to fix a loose sandbag at P-F9. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Lucien "Brick" Yuas of the Concord (@krauser.yuas).
Leopold Tec came to the front because his uncle Lucien "Parson" Tec never came home. He carries his mother's thimble.
Leopold Tec smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Bram "Button" Nailonailon came out for a cup and was badly wounded.
Leopold offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
klaymore817: Ivo "Saint" Klaymore joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Ivo "Saint" Klaymore folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

At S-C13 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Ivo "Saint" Klaymore won the bet. Nils Connor was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Ivo "Saint" Klaymore answered to number 942. Ivo "Saint" Klaymore walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Shrapnel at the Brickworks. Ivo "Saint" Klaymore walked to the medics on his own feet and asked for a cigarette before the stitches.
Ivo "Saint" Klaymore returned to S-C13 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Ivo "Saint" Klaymore got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Ivo "Saint" Klaymore fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Bram Nathangrundm was badly wounded. Ivo "Saint" Klaymore ate breakfast without a word.
Ivo "Saint" Klaymore counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Nils Connor was badly wounded.
Ivo "Saint" Klaymore tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Ivo wrote a song about Lantern Hill. Tobias Padraiggalla wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
litti105: Bastian "Spark" Litti arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Bastian "Spark" Litti was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Bastian "Spark" Litti helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Bastian "Spark" Litti saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
Bastian "Spark" Litti followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.
Bastian "Spark" Litti drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
The relief reached P-F9 without Bastian "Spark" Litti. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead.
The squad at P-F9 still leaves a gap on the fire step where Bastian "Spark" Litti used to stand.
Bastian "Spark" Litti is still missing. The sergeant keeps his name on the roll and calls it out every morning anyway.
Bastian reappeared at P-F9 carrying a scrap of map from another unit. The route home had been drawn over somebody's shopping list.
marcusho64: Day 8. The corporal put Dietrich Marcusho beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Dietrich Marcusho cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Dietrich Marcusho let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Dietrich Marcusho fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Felix Ryanstebbins was grazed. Dietrich Marcusho ate breakfast without a word. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dietrich Marcusho is number 536. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Dietrich Marcusho during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Brass cases piled up around Dietrich Marcusho's boots at R-S3. Out of all those rounds, one found Yann Zhai, badly wounded.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Dietrich Marcusho offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Dietrich Marcusho fixed the strap on Isidor "Tin" Brayden's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Dietrich Marcusho fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Felix Ryanstebbins, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. Dietrich Marcusho fired at a movement across the wire at R-S3. The man went down: Dietrich Mindblot, grazed.
Dietrich Marcusho held the mirror while Tobias Gorilla shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

A bullet went into Dietrich Marcusho's chest just under the heart at R-S3. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Tobias Htmmci of the Concord (@htmmci). Dietrich Marcusho was killed outright at R-S3, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Tobias Htmmci of the Concord (@htmmci).
Another member of the House of Marcusho reached the line: Hugo Marcusho. He asked where Dietrich Marcusho had slept, then chose a different corner.
Hugo had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Pavel Rozzyadog was grazed.
mattias_vicuna: Silas "Rabbit" Vicuna arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pressed cornflower and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

A single shot from across the wire hit Silas "Rabbit" Vicuna in the thigh at N-F21. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Gustav Godzillasmyb of the Concord (@godzillasmybodyguard). A single shot at N-F21. Silas "Rabbit" Vicuna sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Gustav Godzillasmyb of the Concord (@godzillasmybodyguard).
Viktor "Smokes" Vicuna arrived carrying the family name of Silas "Rabbit" Vicuna. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Viktor "Smokes" Vicuna fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Isidor Blyat, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.

At N-F21 a round caught Viktor below the ribs. He sat down slowly against the trench wall and said, quite calmly, that it hurt. Shot by Gustav Godzillasmyb of the Concord (@godzillasmybodyguard). A sharpshooter across the wire killed Viktor at N-F21. The squad covered him with a blanket and wrote down the hour.
Ulrich Vicuna put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Viktor "Smokes" Vicuna helped clear the shelf without saying why.
odin21320: Lucien Odin introduced himself as a brewer from Coldwater. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Lucien Odin kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Lucien Odin swept the enemy parapet at S-C13 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Benedikt Larson was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Lucien Odin is number 716. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Lucien Odin wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Lucien Odin in the open at S-C13. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Teodor Donaldgregor of the Hegemony (@donaldgregory334). Lucien Odin was hit at S-C13 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Teodor Donaldgregor of the Hegemony (@donaldgregory334).
Another member of the House of Odin reached the line: Emil "Mole" Odin. He asked where Lucien Odin had slept, then chose a different corner.
Emil "Mole" Odin fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at S-C13. Before dawn Albin "Shadow" Dick walked into it, grazed.
A clear shot from S-C13. Emil "Mole" Odin badly wounded Severin "Smokes" Bananaman and slid back down below the parapet.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Florian Tetanusmaxxe, gravely wounded. Emil "Mole" Odin cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor stood up to sing louder, and Emil "Mole" Odin fired. Marek "Parson" Donaldgregor was badly wounded. The singing stopped.
The dugout at S-C13 took a direct hit. Emil "Mole" Odin was pulled out last, still breathing.
Emil sat up in bed, drank some soup, and complained about the soup. Everyone in the ward cheered.
thorkill261: Otto Thorkill arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Otto Thorkill wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Otto Thorkill won a pocket watch that does not work at cards from a lance corporal in Q-F6. The lance corporal wants a rematch. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Otto Thorkill stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Otto Thorkill held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Otto Thorkill has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Rematch. Otto Thorkill lost everything he won, plus a stub of a pencil. The whole dugout watched.
Otto Thorkill opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Otto Thorkill borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Wendel This taught Otto Thorkill three words in the language of home. Otto uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
Otto Thorkill taught Marek Xmrmememanx how to tie a perfect knot. Marek Xmrmememanx used it to tie Marek boots together by mistake.
timothy_mccarter: The old hands of T-F1 have been here since Day 1. Oskar Mccarter has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Oskar Mccarter traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Oskar Mccarter wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Arno Soldat held the mirror while Oskar Mccarter shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Oskar Mccarter's ear at T-F1 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe of the Concord (@kjwthe1).
Oskar Mccarter rejoined the squad at T-F1. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Oskar Mccarter caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Oskar Mccarter (Hegemony) and Bastian "Ghost" Kgss (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Verdel Ridge. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Isidor Akkugrg of the Concord spotted Oskar Mccarter of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Verdel Ridge. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Oskar peeked through a loophole and saw a rabbit between the lines. For a moment, nobody fired.
zebra.1924046: In Millbank, Yann Zebra was a glassblower. In U-F14, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a glassblower again.

Yann Zebra borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. Yann Zebra walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Yann Zebra fixed the strap on Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. A letter from home found Yann Zebra before the night shift. Yann Zebra folded it small and kept it close.
Yann Zebra began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Yann Zebra tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-S9 is up. A letter from home found Yann Zebra before the night shift. Yann Zebra folded it small and kept it close.
Word of Yann Zebra's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
The corporal found out Yann Zebra used to be a glassblower. Yann Zebra has been doing two jobs ever since. The corporal called out the mail. Yann Zebra heard the name and almost ran.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Yann Zebra. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
The last report placed Yann near Grey Mill. By evening, no later report had arrived. Missing.
zer0_gundam: Rafael Gundam arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in R-C5 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Rafael Gundam borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Nils "Ghost" Moregano was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Rafael Gundam helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Rafael Gundam. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. Rafael Gundam got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 795. The men who came later will ask about it. Victory at Grey Mill. Rafael Gundam let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Rafael Gundam spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Brickworks. Rafael Gundam fired. Valentin Coleharrison pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
Albin "Shadow" Cymru kept watch so that Rafael Gundam could sleep. Then Rafael kept watch so that Shadow could. Neither slept.
Albin "Shadow" Cymru pulled Rafael Gundam out of a flooded shell hole at Sorrow Copse. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Rafael Gundam aimed just below it. Teodor "Button" Magtyu was badly wounded.
Rafael Gundam got a letter from Helene. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Rafael and Karel "Doc" One found a cat in the ruins at Sorrow Copse and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Doc.
